meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Mainland China (PRC) - Taiwan-invested WFOE formation; investment source jurisdiction: Taiwan

Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Enhancement of Tax Cooperation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746, effective 1 March 2022, as amended); Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 Revision, effective 1 November 2024); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Ownership Information of Market Entities (People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China and its Implementing Regulations; Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act for the upstream investor KYC trail.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Current Company Registration Record of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, China - Commercial Registration Authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notary public notarization; then recordation through Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) and verification by the applicable PRC provincial notary association under the ARATS/SEF Cross-Strait verification channel. This specialized channel is the exclusive substitute for consular legalization; no Hague Apostille may be attached because Taiwan is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of No Outstanding Tax Liabilities of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, China; Taiwan National Taxation Bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Each certificate is separately notarized in Taiwan and then transmitted through SEF to the mainland-side authorized notary association for Cross-Strait verification. This is a parallel and mutually exclusive authentication track to Hague Apostille; consular legalization through PRC embassies is not available for Taiwan-origin documents and must not be layered onto an Apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing the incorporation of the CN WFOE and appointing the legal representative and bank signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original signed board resolution and PoA, notarized by a Taiwan notary public, then forwarded through SEF and verified by the relevant mainland provincial notary association. The authentication path is Cross-Strait notarial verification only; no Hague Apostille or consular legalization step is added.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Charter) of the Taiwan investing company (consolidated and current version)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan investing company; MOEA company registration record
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Taiwan-origin originals: Taiwan notarization plus SEF/ARATS Cross-Strait verification. For any original instrument issued from a Hague Convention state relating to the same corporate group, a standalone Hague Apostille may be used, but it must never be combined with PRC consular legalization or Cross-Strait verification in the same chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and AML/CFT account relationship package of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan relationship bank (remitting bank for SWIFT LC and TT wire payment rails)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank reference letter on original bank letterhead, signed by authorized bank officer, notarized in Taiwan, and verified through the SEF/ARATS Cross-Strait notarial channel. If the bank also issues a direct SWIFT MT199 or MT799 relationship confirmation, that SWIFT authenticated message may supplement but cannot replace the verified notarial package; no Apostille or diplomatic consular legalization is used.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All shareholders, directors, supervisors, legal representatives, authorized signatories, actual controllers and all beneficial owners holding directly or indirectly at least 25% of the WFOE or exercising control through other means must be continuously screened against: UN Security Council Consolidated Lists; OFAC SDN and Non-SDN sanctions lists; US Sectoral Sanctions where applicable; EU and UK consolidated sanctions; FATF high-risk and monitored jurisdiction lists; PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs sanctions announcements; PRC Ministry of Public Security wanted and terrorism lists; SAMR/PBOC adverse registry and beneficial ownership records; and the competent Taiwan AML/CFT records. PEP assessment covers domestic, foreign and international PEPs, including immediate family members and close associates. Enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation, source-of-funds evidence, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring are mandatory. Screening must be refreshed at formation, upon any material change in ownership or control, and at least quarterly thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Self-Declaration and Registration System; local municipal SAMR online government service portal for WFOE name reservation and business license filing.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name of a PRC WFOE must be in simplified Chinese characters and must follow the mandatory four-tier structure: administrative division, unique trade name of not fewer than two Chinese characters, industry or operational characteristics, and company form. The Chinese name is authoritative for registry, tax, customs, foreign-exchange, and banking purposes. Pinyin romanization or an English name may be used as a registered translation in the Articles of Association, but it does not replace the Chinese legal name. The trade name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name and must not mislead as to the company nature or business scope.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name declaration is rejected, the applicant should first correct and resubmit through the SAMR enterprise name self-declaration platform to preserve the right of appeal. A written refusal letter enables an administrative reconsideration application to the next-higher SAMR or the same-level people's government within 60 days of receipt. If the reconsideration outcome is unfavorable, an administrative lawsuit may be filed in the competent people's court within 15 days of the reconsideration decision, or within 6 months if administrative reconsideration is not pursued. A reserved name may also be extended by applying before expiry, generally once for up to 180 additional days under local SAMR practice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a Taiwan-invested WFOE manufacturing and exporting color Doppler ultrasound consoles under ISIC 3250 / NAICS 334510, a virtual office, home address, or commercial mailbox-only arrangement is rejected. The SAMR requires a fixed registered domicile; the tax authority requires an actual address capable of receiving unannounced verification and invoice inspection; banks will not open corporate accounts without a physical site visit; and customs and foreign-exchange administrations require the registered address to align with the stated manufacturing and export business. Municipal cluster-registration or incubation-address regimes may be permitted only for non-manufacturing administrative service companies; this WFOE must have a physical, exclusive-use commercial or industrial registered office in the same administrative district as the eventual production facility, plus a separate confirmed medical-device manufacturing premises before NMPA licensing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced inspection: original lease agreement and landlord title evidence; rent invoices and bank payment trail; company signboard; actual workstations and employee attendance records; production or assembly equipment and procurement contracts; inventory and spare parts; ISO 13485 / GMP quality records; NMPA license progression; electronic invoicing UKey and tax registration; social insurance and payroll records; foreign-exchange capital verification; SWIFT LC/TT receipt records; and proof that the registered address is not a mailbox. Quantified risk: approximately 72% likelihood of a municipal tax bureau unannounced site inspection within the first 12 months; approximately 58% likelihood

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act (公司法) of Taiwan, Articles 6 (incorporation), 7 (capital verification by CPA), 98-113 (limited company (有限公司) governance), 387 (registration filing); Foreign Investment Act (外國人投資條例), Articles 5-8; Act Governing Relations between Peoples of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例), Article 73, and the Regulations for the Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland-Area People (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法), Articles 4-6.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Administration of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部商業發展署), with delegation to the municipal business registration office of the special municipality in which the registered office is located; investment approvals handled by the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議司).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application Form (公司設立登記申請書), submitted through the Company and Commerce One-Stop Online Service Platform (公司與商業一站式線上申請作業網路系統), together with the Mainland-Area Investment Permit Application (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可申請書) where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital under the Company Act; however, the Investment Commission assesses capital adequacy against the business plan, and for a medical-device manufacturing WFOE a paid-in capital of at least NT$1,000,000 is market-standard. Capital must be remitted into a Taiwanese NT$ bank account held in the company's name and verified by a certified public accountant before registration; no formal escrow account is mandated by law, but the funds must remain unwithdrawn in the account until the company is registered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the sole shareholder's paid-in capital subscription of NT$5,000,000 is ratified; the draft Articles of Incorporation are adopted; the registered office is fixed at No. 12, Lane 7, Sec. 2, Zhongshan N. Rd., Zhongshan Dist., Taipei; Director A and Supervisor B are appointed, and Director A is elected Chairman and General Manager; the Chairman is authorized to open banking accounts, apply for the unified business tax number, procure company seals, file all incorporation documents, and execute the medical device manufacturer's license and factory registration applications; and a licensed CPA is engaged to perform capital verification and tax registration. The incorporator's actions are ratified and this resolution is effective from the date of the company's establishment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Food and Drug Administration, Ministry of Health and Welfare (衛生福利部食品藥物管理署, TFDA), in coordination with the municipal industrial development bureau and local fire department for factory clearances.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Devices Manufacturer License (醫療器材製造許可) and Factory Registration Certificate (工廠登記證) for the manufacture of color Doppler ultrasound diagnostic consoles.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (環境部), Environmental Impact Assessment Review Committee (環境影響評估審查委員會), with municipal Environmental Protection Bureau enforcement.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C – Statutory Exemption/Self-Declaration Registration: a low-pollution electronics assembly facility under 1 hectare is exempt from a Full EIA Report but must submit an Environmental Protection Facility Self-Declaration (環境保護措施自述書) and obtain a wastewater discharge permit or sewer connection approval.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent must comply with the Water Pollution Control Act standards (pH 6-9, SS ≤30 mg/L, COD ≤100 mg/L); VOC emissions from cleaning/soldering processes are subject to reporting if solvent consumption exceeds 300 kg/year, and hazardous waste manifests must be filed under the Waste Disposal Act with disposal contractor approval.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (消防安全設備檢修證明) and fire protection construction approval from the local Fire Bureau; building use permit endorsed for industrial/manufacturing use; structural load inspection certificate for the factory floor; occupational safety and health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, including machine guarding, emergency response plans, and, if applicable, registration of the company's occupational safety management plan with the local labor inspection office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration of Commerce, MOEA, or the delegated municipal business registration office through the Company One-Stop Online Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the online incorporation application with the articles, CPA capital verification report, director and supervisor consent letters, registered office consent/lease document, and the filing fee; once approved, the authority issues the Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書) and assigns the unified business number; immediately thereafter file the factory registration application to obtain the Factory Registration Certificate and apply for the Medical Devices Manufacturer License with TFDA under the Medical Devices Act.
required_dossiers: Investment Commission permission letter and inward remittance certificate
Director's and supervisor's consent letters with identity documents
Registered office consent letter and lease or ownership certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a defect-correction notice (補正通知), cure the stated items within 15 days; if the 15-day period is insufficient, lodge a written extension request before expiry; if the application is rejected, refile with full corrections and, if the defect relates to a legal determination, seek administrative appeal within 30 days.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局, STA); operational filings executed through the unified China Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局, etax.chinatax.gov.cn) under the local competent national tax service bureau at the WFOE's registered address; medical-device export licensing coordinated with the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and its provincial bureaus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a newly incorporated WFOE: (1) obtain the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码, USCC) on the business license issued by the Administration for Market Regulation; the USCC legally serves as the TIN for tax, customs, banking, and social-insurance purposes. (2) Complete mandatory tax registration within 30 days from business-license issuance through the e-Tax Bureau portal, filing registered address, legal representative real-name verification, bank account filing, and tax categories (CIT, VAT, stamp duty, urban-maintenance surtax, education surcharge, and withholding tax on non-resident payments). (3) Apply for general VAT taxpayer status; a manufacturer-exporter of medical devices normally elects general status to unlock zero-rated export refund mechanics. (4) Activate digital-invoice issuance credentials under the STA Golden Tax 'fully digital e-invoice' (全电发票) platform. (5) Complete export-tax-rebate registration (出口退(免)税备案) with the competent tax bureau and customs registration in the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — A PRC-incorporated WFOE is a Chinese tax resident under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 2 and is taxed at entity level at the statutory 25% CIT rate on worldwide income; no pass-through or check-the-box transparency exists for LLC-type WFOEs. Cross-strait investment is protected under the Law on the Protection of Investment by Taiwanese Compatriots, but the WFOE remains a PRC resident enterprise in all mainland tax filings. Distributions to the Taiwan corporate shareholder are subject to 10% final dividend withholding (no formal cross-strait double-tax agreement, so no treaty-rate reduction); foreign tax credits are granted unilaterally for qualified foreign-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China operates no check-the-box regime. Available elections include: (i) small-scale (3% statutory, temporarily reduced to 1% through 2027) versus general VAT taxpayer status (13%/9%/6%), with mandatory general registration above RMB 5 million annual sales; (ii) export-rebate method election: 'exemption-credit-refund' (免抵退) for manufacturers versus 'exemption-refund' (免退税) for trading agents; (iii) High-and-New-Technology Enterprise status at a 15% reduced CIT rate, with R&D-to-sales ratios of 5% (sales ≤ RMB 50 million), 4% (RMB 50–200 million), or 3% (above RMB 200 million) and at least 60% high-tech revenue concentration; (iv) accelerated depreciation for fixed assets under Cai Shui 2018 No. 54; (v) no hybrid-mismatch or CFC deferral election: PRC CFC attribution under EIT Law Article 45 applies to passive income parked in Taiwan-owned offshore vehicles, and thin-capitalization restricts related-party debt to a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio; (vi) 10% withholding on outbound dividend/service remittances, verified against the applicable DTA (none available for Taiwan).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (增值税, VAT) — a national unified system administered by the STA; exports of goods are taxed at 0% with refund of input VAT; no separate GST or sales-and-use tax applies in mainland China.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable sales: a WFOE whose forecast or actual annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5 million must register as a general VAT taxpayer at the 13% goods rate; turnover at or below RMB 5 million may elect small-scale taxpayer status (simplified 1% levy through 2027). A manufacturing WFOE engaged in export zero-rating must adopt general taxpayer status because small-scale taxpayers cannot claim input-VAT refunds on exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Golden Tax Phase IV (金税四期): every VAT special invoice issued by the WFOE must be created in real time on the STA digital invoice platform, carry the taxpayer's digital certificate and the tax authority's electronic stamp/QR code, and be transmitted to the national database in the same session; invoice numbers are centrally allocated, and manual off-platform issuance is effectively abolished for general taxpayers. Export customs clearance is fully paperless through the China International Trade Single Window (中国国际贸易单一窗口) with real-time electronic matching of export declarations, VAT invoices, and foreign-exchange receipts. The zero-rated export VAT return and export-rebate application are filed electronically as an integrated schedule of the general VAT return, with auto-verification by the rebate risk-control system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Physical export of domestically manufactured color-Doppler ultrasound consoles (HS 9018.12) qualifies for zero-rating under the VAT Export Rebate rules (Cai Shui 2012 No. 39 and Interim VAT Regulations Article 15): output VAT at 0% and full refund of the input VAT attributable to the export, applied at the 13% rebate rate (a full rebate for this medical-device category). Conditions: the exporter is a general VAT taxpayer; the goods actually depart PRC customs territory; the WFOE holds a valid NMPA medical-device production registration for the console; sales proceeds are received through a designated foreign-exchange bank within the statutory collection period; and electronic matching among the customs declaration, VAT invoice, and FX settlement is verifiable. Offshore installation, training, and remote-diagnostic services supplied to a non-PRC buyer qualify for zero-rating only where the service is not consumed within China and the recipient is outside the PRC (Cai Shui 2016 No. 36).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Original Customs Export Declaration Form (出口货物报关单) transmitted electronically via the China International Trade Single Window
Export VAT Special Invoice (增值税专用发票) matched to the customs declaration in the national export-rebate database
Bill of Lading (ocean/multimodal) or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the ultrasound console from PRC customs territory
Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and Export Sales Contract (purchase order)
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Foreign-Exchange Settlement Record (结汇水单) evidencing receipt of export proceeds through a designated bank
Export Sales Certificate for Medical Devices (医疗器械出口销售证明) issued by the provincial NMPA for the color-Doppler console model
Customs clearance authorization / power of attorney to the licensed customs declarant (if clearance is outsourced)
Foreign-exchange collection verification record from the SAFE Trade Monitoring System confirming receipt within the statutory 180-day collection period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA export-rebate risk-control engine continuously matches customs declarations, VAT invoices, logistics bills, and SAFE foreign-exchange receipts; anomalies trigger written verification (函调) to the supplier's tax bureau and on-site inspections of production capacity and cost structure. A false or fraudulent export zero-rating claim causes: (i) mandatory repayment of the refunded VAT with a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%; (ii) an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the falsely refunded tax under Article 63 of the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection; (iii) downgrade of the taxpayer credit rating to Level D and suspension of export tax-rebate privileges; and (iv) criminal prosecution under Article 204 of the Criminal Law for fraud in export tax refunds (骗取出口退税罪), carrying imprisonment up to five years for basic fraud, up to ten years for 'huge' amounts, and life imprisonment for 'especially huge' amounts, together with forfeiture of the illegal proceeds and monetary fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC / 中国人民银行) as the central bank, acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE / 国家外汇管理局) as the delegated foreign-exchange regulator. SAFE administers the Trade Monitoring System (货物贸易外汇监测系统), the Foreign Exchange Capital Project Information System, the cross-border receipt/payment reporting framework, and the FDI foreign-exchange registration regime for inbound equity and capital-account flows. For RMB crossing with Taiwan, the PBOC Cross-Border RMB Clearing Arrangement (2012 Cross-Strait Currency Clearing Cooperation Memorandum) applies through the Taipei RMB clearing bank (Bank of China Taipei Branch) plus the CIPS reporting node.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is fully convertible for current-account transactions (China accepted IMF Article VIII obligations in 1996), so China WFOE LTD may remit dividends, royalties, and trade settlements with bank-based verification rather than SAFE pre-approval. Capital-account convertibility remains a managed, negative-list regime: inbound FDI equity injections require a one-time SAFE FDI registration executed at the accepting bank, while outbound capital movements (intercompany loans, guarantees, offshore M&A) sit on an approval/negative-list track. Profit remittance hurdles: (1) distributable profits must exist under the PRC GAAP audited balance sheet; (2) a board/owners' profit-distribution resolution must be passed; (3) corporate income tax and the 10% dividend withholding tax must be settled - reducible to 5% under the Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation where the Taiwan shareholder holds at least 10% equity and passes beneficial-ownership/substance verification; and (4) the bank must verify the annual Foreign Investment Information Report and the negative-list position of the business. The manufacturing of Color Doppler Ultrasound Console equipment (ISIC 3250 / NAICS 334510) is outside the negative list and eligible for encouraged-industry treatment, so no industry-level convertibility prohibition applies. Dividend conversion from RMB into USD is executed at the receiving bank against the audited financial statements, board resolution, tax payment certificates, and the BOP transaction code 322033 (profit repatriation), ordinarily within one to two business days for Class-A enterprises.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The historic fixed-percentage mandatory surrender of export proceeds was abolished by SAFE Circular HuiFa [2012] No. 38. There is therefore no statutory conversion ratio: China WFOE LTD may retain 100% of export receipts in foreign currency within its current-account FX account, or settle them voluntarily into RMB (意愿结汇), including into a RMB settlement-pending account. The binding duties are: (a) all export receipts must enter an SAFE-registered current-account FX account; (b) receipts must reconcile with the corresponding customs declaration (报关单), bill of lading, and invoice under the total-amount verification (总量核查) methodology; (c) if collection occurs more than 90 days after the export customs-clearance date, the exporter must file a deferred-collection notification (延期收款报告) in the Trade Monitoring System within the statutory reporting window (typically before the 15th day of the month following expiry of the 90-day period); (d) advance receipts for exports that are more than 30 days before shipment or that exceed the equivalent of USD 300,000 must be reported to the bank; and (e) Class-A trade status, granted by default to newly registered WFOEs without sanctions or prior irregularity, enables streamlined single-transaction or batch verification with no mandatory conversion timeline.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury or capital management; LOW-to-MEDIUM for ancillary export collection only. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Currenxie, Payoneer) hold no PBOC banking licence and no SAFE foreign-exchange settlement licence. They cannot legally open a PRC capital-account, cannot hold a RMB settlement-pending account, and cannot issue the CNP-format (人民币跨境收付) payment recording that SAFE accepts for trade verification. A China-domiciled WFOE may use an EMI only as an ancillary collection aggregator within the cross-border e-commerce pilot via a cooperating licensed PRC payment institution/bank, but that channel is incompatible with the SWIFT LC / commercial TT clearing rails specified for this medical-device export business: the LC advising/confirming chain requires SWIFT member PRC banks. Routing capital injections or outbound trade disbursements through an offshore EMI would create third-party payment mismatches under HuiFa [2012] No. 38 and PBOC payment-account rules, risking downgrade of trade classification from Class A to Class B and forced per-transaction documentary examination. Recommended architecture: primary accounts at licensed banks; EMI exposure limited to low-value complementary collections fully reconciled to invoices and customs records through the primary bank's virtual-account integration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for initial account opening of a newly formed WFOE. PBOC Account Opening Administrative Measures and bank-level KYC policies require the legal representative, or a duly notarized and consular/apostilled authorized representative, to appear in person at the bank branch carrying the original business licence, the company seal (公章), the legal representative's personal seal (法人章), the financial seal (财务专用章), and the general seal (发票章), and to complete a face-to-face interview conducted by the account officer together with a second compliance officer ('dual-person verification' / 双人核实). Remote video opening is not permitted for the initial RMB basic deposit account and is excluded with greater strictness for the FX capital account. Electronic pre-filling of PBOC and bank-interface forms is allowed, but the signing of the settlement agreement, U-Shield (U盾) activation, and PIN configuration occur in-branch. For subsequent operational FX accounts at the same bank, an authorized finance manager may act under a notarized power of attorney with the corporate seal, while the bank's OFAC/red-flag screening remains software-driven. For Taiwan-resident legal representatives, the Taiwan ID or ARC plus a Taiwan-issued certified corporate dossier is accepted, but in-person appearance is still the statutory verification step.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International capital-flow mismatch: the capital injection remitter's name differs from the registered shareholder of the WFOE, or the funds pass through a non-transparent intermediary chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Certified copy of the overseas shareholder's certificate of incorporation and register of members; (2) the PRC business licence and SAFE FDI registration code (FDI外汇登记编码); (3) board/owners' resolution calling registered capital with the payment schedule; (4) SWIFT MT103 showing the remitter name exactly matching the shareholder; (5) source-of-funds statement from the shareholder with bank statements evidencing accumulated profits or a documented shareholder loan; (6) signed Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report filing receipt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity: nominee or shell layers in the Taiwan/offshore parent chain prevent identification of any natural person holding 25%+ interest, triggering PBOC Beneficial-Owner Identification rules (PBOC 2017/2020) and the bank's standard UBO forms.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Consolidated ownership chart tracing through each intermediate entity; (2) corporate registers, director/service lists, and nominee declarations from each jurisdiction (Taiwan MOEA company data, offshore registers); (3) passport/ARC and proof-of-address copies of all identified natural persons; (4) signed UBO declaration on the bank's standard form; (5) if no 25% UBO can be identified, a senior-management attestation executed under the PBOC Notice on Strengthening Beneficial-Owner Identification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business-scope mismatch: the AMR/SAIC business licence does not expressly include manufacturing of class-II medical imaging ultrasound equipment, so the bank's industry-risk model flags the entity as a shell.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Updated PRC business licence including 'manufacturing of medical ultrasonic diagnostic imaging equipment (class II 6823/6840)' or equivalent approved wording; (2) NMPA Medical Device Registration Certificate (医疗器械注册证) for the Color Doppler Ultrasound Console; (3) Medical Device Production License (医疗器械生产许可证); (4) production facility lease, equipment purchase invoices, and site photographs; (5) customs registration and export-participation declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment-beneficiary inconsistency for outbound trade: the Taiwan LC beneficiary or TT recipient is an agent or related party rather than the party named on the invoice and customs declaration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Signed commercial contract disclosing the agent's role and commission; (2) commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading showing the same parties as the LC; (3) customs declaration (报关单) matching value, quantity, and Hs code 9018.12 (ultrasound equipment); (4) transfer-pricing benchmark analysis if the Taiwan counterparty is affiliated; (5) written bank-to-bank confirmation that trade documents are original and unmodified.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and dual-use scrutiny: medical imaging consoles may trigger export-control and sanctions screening for potential military/dual-use end-use or for sensitive geographies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) End-use certificate and end-user statement from the Taiwan buyer; (2) product technical specification demonstrating non-military civil design plus NMPA registration; (3) analysis of whether any component (e.g., phased-array transducer module) is on PRC dual-use control lists, with export license if applicable; (4) the bank's completed sanctions questionnaire signed by beneficial owners; (5) final destination and ultimate-end-user confirmation aligned with LC fields 50 and 59.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Step 1: China WFOE LTD completes SAFE FDI registration through the accepting bank's direct-investment online module, obtaining the FDI code and replacing the former MOFCOM-approval system with the informational Foreign Investment Report. Step 2: The bank opens the PBOC-registered RMB basic deposit account (基本存款账户), then the designated FX capital account (资本金账户) in USD / RMB / TWD, matching the Articles of Association currency denomination. Step 3: The overseas shareholder, with an exact name match to the AMR registration, remits registered capital via SWIFT MT103 (USD) or CIPS/CNP (RMB) using the BOP transaction code 622014 (foreign direct investment - new investment in foreign-invested enterprises); the remitter's bank account must belong to the shareholder. Step 4: Incoming funds are credited to the capital account and matched in SAFE's Foreign Exchange Capital Project Information System; the bank then verifies paid-in equity against the registered capital amount and the board resolution. Step 5: The WFOE exercises voluntary FX settlement (意愿结汇) converting the USD capital into RMB in a ring-fenced settlement-pending account (结汇待支付账户); disbursement is then made on a payment-against-invoice basis or, for compliance-validated enterprises, under the nationwide capital-account income payment facilitation pilot. Step 6: Permitted uses include raw materials, equipment, payroll, rent, R&D, and taxes; prohibited uses are securities investment beyond bank wealth-management product quotas, entrusted loans or RMB-loan repayment outside pilot carve-outs, investment in real estate not for self-use, and investment in negative-list industries. For Taiwan-investor injections denominated in RMB, same-day reporting to RCPMIS (人民币跨境收付信息管理系统) through the accepting bank and, where applicable, notification to the Taipei RMB clearing bank are required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for the CN-WFOE medical-device export trade to Taiwan and third markets: (i) TT/Wire: outbound SWIFT MT103 from the WFOE's current-account FX account with the bank receiving commercial invoice, packing list, customs declaration (报关单), and transport documents; the cross-border payment declaration (对外付款申报单) must carry the BOP transaction code 121010 (general trade). Class-A trade status allows single-transaction electronic verification or a standing streamlined framework under HuiFa [2012] No. 38, enabling intraday execution. (ii) Commercial Letter of Credit: LC issuance via SWIFT MT700 by the PRC issuing bank, advised/confirmed by a Taiwan bank or by Bank of China Taipei Branch for RMB-denominated LCs; proceeds settle under UCP600 over SWIFT (USD/EUR), CIPS/CNAPS (RMB), or the cross-strait RMB clearing arrangement following the 2012 Currency Clearing Cooperation Memorandum. (iii) RMB trade settlement: the onshore bank uses its CIPS network to credit the Taiwan beneficiary's RMB account at a CIPS participant or via the Taipei clearing bank, with the identical documentary file. Every outbound RMB payment is reported by the bank to RCPMIS, and the WFOE must preserve the 'matching party' principle - the beneficiary must be the customs-declared trading counterparty.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards (远期结售汇) executed with a licensed PRC bank under SAFE real-demand verification against documented physical export receivables or import payables; speculative and one-sided open positions are prohibited.

FX options and option combinations (人民币外汇期权及期权组合), including vanilla calls, vanilla puts, and zero-cost collars, with notional capped at the amount of the hedged trade cash flow and premium payable in RMB.
FX swaps (外汇掉期) with an onshore bank for temporary currency and liquidity bridging between the USD receipt date and the RMB payment date in the same trade cycle.

Cross-currency swaps (货币掉期) for longer-dated FCY-denominated obligations linked to equipment import settlement or scheduled dividend remittance timelines, provided the SAFE documentation of the underlying current-account exposure is retained.

Structuring restriction: offshore NDFs with non-resident counterparties are not permissible for the onshore WFOE; any RMB/USD hedge must be onshore and deliverable, with trade documents retained in the FX derivatives vault. For Taiwan-related invoices, hedge pricing references the onshore CNY (CNY), never the offshore CNH or NDF fixing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual withholding tax statements and remittances for salaries, dividends, interest, royalties, and other taxable income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 January following the calendar year for resident payees; within 10 days of payment for non-resident payees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or unfiled statements attract a penalty of 20% of the under-remitted withheld tax; interest accrues on unpaid amounts; enforced collection may proceed against company assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs company registry and Financial Intelligence Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from NT$50,000 to NT$5,000,000 under the Money Laundering Control Act; continuing daily penalties may be imposed after notice; persistent non-compliance may lead to administrative dissolution by the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign or Mainland investor annual investment status return and business report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after fiscal year end (on or before 31 March for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may suspend or revoke investment approval, restrict dividend and profit remittance privileges, and subject the company to monetary penalties under the applicable investment regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-seeking enterprise income tax settlement return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May through 31 May of the year following the tax year for calendar-year filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an additional 10% penalty on tax assessed, plus statutory interest for late payment; continued non-payment can lead to asset seizure, tax registration suspension, and compulsory enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory books and registers audit certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered office / corporate secretariat; available for examination by the Ministry of Economic Affairs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Complete no later than 30 June of the year following the reporting year, in connection with preparation for the annual general meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inadequate statutory registers and minute books expose the company to administrative fines under the Taiwan Company Act, director liability for misstatements, and, in serious or repeated cases, an order for administrative dissolution.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced to 15% for a qualified High-and-New Technology Enterprise (HNTE) under EIT Law Art. 28 and 国家税务总局公告2016年第68号; effective 5% for a Small Low-Profit Enterprise (annual taxable income ≤ RMB 3 million, assets ≤ RMB 50 million, employees ≤ 300) through 2027 under Announcement 2023 No. 12; 100% additional deduction (200% total) for qualifying R&D expenses; 10-year loss carryforward for HNTEs and Small Low-Profit Enterprises; accelerated depreciation for equipment ≥ RMB 5 million; no special CIT holiday exists for medical device manufacturers, but the export of color Doppler ultrasound consoles qualifies for a 13% VAT export rebate (non-CIT item relevant to net cash flow).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly Prepayment Return 企业所得税预缴纳税申报表（A类, 2018 revision, Form A200000）; filed electronically via the State Taxation Administration's e-Taxation portal (电子税务局, etax.chinatax.gov.cn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 calendar days after the end of each fiscal quarter: April 15, July 15, October 15, and January 15.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative operating revenue, accrual basis, including all export sales of color Doppler ultrasound consoles and related after-sales services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise and must report worldwide income; export proceeds settled via SWIFT LC or TT wire are included at the spot or monthly average exchange rate per tax rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative cost of sales including imported phased-array transducers, console assembly, labor, and depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchases from the Taiwan group must respect the arm's length principle and be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative accounting profit for the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile with PRC GAAP or IFRS statutory financial statements; tax adjustments are entered below this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable actual profit after excluding nontaxable income, tax-exempt income, and deductible prior-year losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Base for the quarterly instalment; loss carryforward applies up to 5 years (10 years for HNTE or Small Low-Profit Enterprise).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable rate multiplied by Line 11: 25% statutory, 15% for qualified HNTE, or effective 5% for Small Low-Profit Enterprise.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the rate for the full fiscal year; no special non-resident rate differentiation applies to the domestic payer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Instalment tax payable after deducting prepayments of the prior quarters of the same year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Overpayments carry forward to later quarters; final refunds or balances are settled in the annual final settlement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: RMB 2,000–10,000 fine (RMB 10,000–50,000 in serious cases) under TCAL Art. 62; late payment surcharge 0.05% per day of the unpaid tax; compulsory collection measures (bank account garnishment, seizure of goods) under TCAL Art. 40; persistent default may trigger suspension of export tax rebates and regulatory license review.
